source: sars-guide:SARS ETI page ("How much is the incentive"; employee conditions), fetched 2026-11-07
notes: June 2025, employee aged 24, employed since 1 March 2025, R4 000 for 160 hours = R25.00 an hour, below the R28.79 national minimum wage, so not a qualifying employee: ETI nil. (With fewer hours at or above the minimum, ETI would be apportioned below R1 500.) PAYE nil, UIF 40.00, SDL 40.00, net 3 960.00. National minimum wage R28.79 an ordinary hour from 1 March 2025 (Minister of Employment and Labour, gov.za media statement 5 Feb 2025, "binding from 1 March 2025"; GN R. 5830, Gazette 52053): R4 606.40 for 160 hours. SARS: the employee must be paid at least the minimum wage, and ETI for fewer than 160 hours is grossed up to 160 and the result grossed down by the same ratio.
